test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate to fill in the blank.

I completed my learner's driving test last week. When am I going to get my _____ license?
solution: The correct answer is "**Permanent**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence makes it understood that we need an appropriate **adjective **from the given options that explains the long lasting driving license. • Out of the given options, **Permanent **is the only word which makes sense here as the driver has already completed the learner's driving test and he is asking for the **permanent **driving license. • **Permanent** (**adjective**) : lasting for a long time or forever; that will not change(देर तक या सदा के लिए रहने वाला, स्‍थायी; अपरिवर्तित, जो न बदले). • **Example:*** You can apply for a **permanent** licence after 30 days from the date of issuance of a learner's licence.* • Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • ** Constant(adjective) :**that does not change(एक समान; स्थिर, अपरिवर्तनीय) • ** Final(adjective):**not to be changed.(जिसे बदला नहीं जा सकता; अंतिम, निर्णायक) • ** Lasting**(**adjective**) : continuing for a long time.(देर तक रहने वाला; (चिर) स्‍थायी) 3c:Tbf0, The correct answer is "**Threatening**".
